name: Attenta Admi Messages – Site Editors' Messages
author: Mousa H

sections.description:
Are you interested in messaging your site editors while staying within your WordPress dashboard? Imagine being able to communicate, share feedback, and manage editorial tasks seamlessly, all without having to switch between different platforms or tools. With this integrated into your WordPress site, you and your editorial team can streamline your workflow, coordinate on content creation, and efficiently manage revisions and approvals. This will not only save time but also enhance productivity and ensure that everyone involved in the publishing process stays on the same page.

Attenta Admi Messages Pro

👉 Pro Demo

  • Seen by whom.
  • Markup and format text.
  • Quote and reply.
  • Messages shortcode.
  • Messages Gutenberg block.
  • Custom access capability.
  • Style settings.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin
  2. Search for Attenta Admi Messages.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this considered a chat plugin?

While this seems like that, it is intended to be messages on the admin dashboard.

Can I have more than one instance of messages?

Yes and no. if you are on multisite installation, you can have one instance of messages per site, but to have more than one instance for same site, no.

How can I include HTML markup?

Unfortunately, the HTML editor is only available on the plugin’s pro version.

Who can access messages in the administration panel?

Any user with the edit_posts cap, essentially the contributor and up to the administrator user role.
